description: Read a card or bank statement (.xlsx, .xls, .csv) and report what is in it: which sheet, where the header row is, what each column looks like and what the app guesses it is, the first rows verbatim, and whether a reader already recognises these columns. Changes nothing — call this before import_statement so the user can confirm the columns. **The user maps the columns; the app only guesses**, so show them this and ask.

amount_convention.description: One of SIGNED_SINGLE, POSITIVE_IS_CHARGE, SEPARATE_DEBIT_CREDIT. Read from the roles when omitted.

columns.description: Try columns without importing: column number → role.

file.description: Absolute path to the statement file. One of .xlsx, .xls, .csv.

header_row.description: Force the header row number, when the guess is wrong.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

sheet.description: Which sheet, when the file has more than one. Defaults to the first.

name: statement_preview
title: Look at a statement file
